blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires models to resolve small visual evidence within extremely large images. Existing approaches typically rely on token pruning, visual search, or tool-augmented reasoning at inference time. We instead investigate whether the benefit of zoom-in visual privilege can be internalized into the model. We introduce RS-OPSD , a reliable privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) framework for UHR remote sensing VQA. To provide high-quality privileged information with explicit question-relevant evidence, we construct GeoEvidence-6K , containing 6,750 VQA samples across seven task categories with evidence-region annotations, and develop Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement (HF-SR) for scalable annotation. To address context loss from tight crops and conflicting signals from imperfect teachers, RS-OPSD introduces Context-Preserving Visual Privilege (CPVP) and Correctness-Aligned Distillation (CAD) . Without any additional visual search or tool calls at inference time, RS-OPSD achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on XLRS-Bench, MME-RealWorld-RS, and LRS-VQA, outperforming pervious SOTA models of comparable scale by an average of 4.0 percentage points. Moreover, our 2B variant, RS-OPD- Lite , surpasses most 8B-scale models while achieving the fastest measured inference speed. Our Code , GeoEvidence-6K , and the model weights for RS-OPSD and RS-OPD- Lite are publicly available.
blocks.zh: 超高分辨率(UHR)遥感视觉问题回答(VQA)需要模型在极大图像中解决小视觉证据. 现有方法通常依赖于象征性的搜索、视觉搜索,或在推论时采用工具辅助推理。 相反,我们调查放大视觉特权的好处是否可以内化为模型。 我们提出RS-OPSD,这是UHR遥感VQA的可靠特权政策自我消化框架。 为了提供高质量的特权信息,提供与问题有关的明确证据,我们构建了GeoEvience-6K,包含6,750个VQA样本,涉及7个任务类别,并附有证据区域说明,并开发了人类反馈指导技能改进(HF-SR),用于可扩展注释。 为了解决收紧作物造成的上下文损失和不完善教师发出的相互矛盾的信号,RS-OPSD引入了上下文保存视觉特权(CPVP)和正正向分化(CAD)。 RS-OPSD在推想时间没有额外的视觉搜索或工具调用,在XLRS-Bench,MME-Real World-RS,和LRS-VQA上实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能,平均比可比尺度的SOTA模型表现优于4.0个百分点. 此外,我们的2B变体RS-OPD-Lite超过了大多数8B级模型,同时实现了所测得的最快推论速度. 我们的代码,GeoEvidence-6K,以及RS-OPSD和RS-OPD-Lite的模型权重是公开的.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: UHR remote sensing VQA requires models to reason over images containing tens of millions of pixels, where the evidence is often confined to only a tiny fraction of the scene. Although modern vision-language foundation models ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) exhibit strong semantic understanding, their effective perceptual capacity is easily overwhelmed by such extremely large visual inputs. Recent studies such as ZoomSearch ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) and Vision-OPD ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) suggest that many fine-grained failures are not simply caused by an inability to recognize the target itself, but by a more fundamental where-to-look bottleneck—the model often fails to effectively attend to and exploit question-relevant visual evidence in extremely large images.
blocks.zh: UHR遥感VQA要求模型对包含上千万像素的图像进行推理,其中证据往往仅限于场景的一小部分. 虽然现代视觉语言基础模型(Bai等,2025年b; Bai等,2025a;Li等,2024;Zhu等,2025)表现出强烈的语义理解,其有效的知觉能力很容易被如此巨大的视觉输入所压倒. 最近的一些研究,如"ZoomSearch"(周克等,2025年)和"Vision-OPD"(袁克等,2026年),都表明,许多细微的失败不仅仅是因为无法识别目标本身,而是由于一个更根本的从外观看的瓶颈——模型往往不能有效地关注和利用极大图像中与问题相关的视觉证据.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 2 , existing approaches mainly address this bottleneck from three directions.
First, token-pruning methods exploit the high redundancy of UHR imagery by retaining only a subset of visual tokens ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ) . However, hard pruning is typically difficult to reverse: once evidence token is discarded, it is no longer available to subsequent reasoning.
Second, visual search methods search over image patches to identify relevant regions before answering ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . While effective, such search introduces additional inference-time computation.
Third, tool-augmented reasoning methods allow the model to actively invoke zoom-in tools during inference, often through multiple rounds of refinement ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These methods demonstrate the benefit of exposing the model to targeted high-resolution views, but require additional tool calls and visual search. This observation motivates a different question: Can the privilege brought by visual zooming be internalized into the model during training, such that it can exploit the same fine-grained visual prior without additional search or tool use?
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,现有办法主要从三个方向解决这一瓶颈。
首先,信使活化法利用UHR图像的高度冗余,只保留了一组视觉信使(Luo等,2025;Dang等,2026)。 然而,硬钻通常难以倒转:一旦丢弃了证据符号,就不再可供后续推理使用.
二,可视化搜索方法 在图像补丁上进行搜索,在回答前确定相关区域(周等,2025;马等,2026. 这种搜索虽然有效,但引入了额外的推断时间计算。
三,工具增强的推理方法使模型在推论中能积极引用缩放工具,往往通过多轮的改进(刘等,2026;王等,2026). 这些方法表明,将模型暴露在有针对性的高分辨率视图中是有益的,但需要额外的工具呼叫和视觉搜索. 这一观点引发了另一个问题: 视觉放大带来的特权能否在训练期间被内化入模型,这样就可以在没有额外搜索或工具使用的情况下,先利用同样的细纹视觉?

blocks.en:
A natural way to realize this idea is on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Instead of introducing additional visual operations at inference time, OPSD equips a teacher with privileged visual information during training and transfers this advantage to a student operating under the standard input.
In UHR remote sensing VQA, zoomed-in evidence can naturally serve as such visual privilege: during training, the teacher is exposed to fine-grained question-relevant views, while the student learns to better exploit the corresponding visual evidence from the standard full-image input.
blocks.zh:
实现这个想法的自然途径是政策上的自我消化(OPSD)(赵等,2026年).
OPSD不是在推论时间引入额外的视觉操作,而是在培训期间为教师提供特权的视觉信息,并将这一优势转移给在标准输入下操作的学生.
在UHR遥感VQA中,放大出的证据可以自然地起到这种视觉特权的作用:在培训期间,老师接触了与问题相关的精细透视,而学生则学习从标准的全图像输入中更好地利用相应的视觉证据.

blocks.en:
Realizing this training paradigm requires high-quality zoom-in evidence as visual privilege.
We therefore construct GeoEvidence-6K , a UHR remote sensing VQA dataset containing 6,750 samples across seven task categories, with explicit annotations for question-relevant visual evidence.
Since accurately annotating such regions requires careful inspection of extremely large images, we further develop Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement (HF-SR) , which progressively incorporates human feedback into reusable annotation skills to improve subsequent data construction.
blocks.zh:
实现这种培训模式需要高质量的放大证据作为视觉特权。
因此,我们构建了GeoEvience-6K,这是一个UHR遥感VQA数据集,包含7个任务类别的6,750个样本,并明确说明与问题有关的视觉证据。
由于精确地说明这些区域需要仔细检查极其庞大的图像,我们进一步发展了人类反馈指导技能强化(HF-SR),它逐步将人类反馈纳入可重复使用的注释技能,以改善随后的数据构建。

blocks.en:
We then conduct a pilot study using full-image inputs for the student and evidence-crop privileges for a teacher initialized from the same model. However, this straightforward formulation yields only marginal gains. We identify two major bottlenecks: first, the crop-only privilege provides only a modest advantage over the student; second, the privileged teacher itself remains imperfect, which can introduce substantial conflicting or even harmful supervision.
To address these issues, we introduce two complementary designs in RS-OPSD . Context-Preserving Visual Privilege (CPVP) equips the teacher with global, contextual, and fine-grained evidence views, strengthening the privileged signal while preserving surrounding context. Correctness-Aligned Distillation (CAD) filters teacher supervision through sample-level reliability gating and retains only token-level update directions aligned with the correctness of the student response.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们进行一项试点研究,利用学生的全能图像投入和从同一模式初始化的教师的证据作物特权。 然而,这种直截了当的提法只产生微不足道的收益。 我们找出了两大瓶颈:第一,只靠作物的特权对学生只提供微弱的优势;第二,特权教师本身仍然不完善,这可以引入实质性相冲突甚至有害的监督.
为了解决这些问题,我们在RS-OPSD中引入了两个互补设计. 上下文-保留视觉特权(CPVP)为教师提供了全局,上下文和精细的证据观点,加强了特权信号,同时保留了周围环境. 正确性-相通分解 (CAD) 通过样本级的可靠性分解来过滤师资监督,并仅保留与学生响应的正确性相一致的符号级更新方向.

blocks.en:
Using Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) as the base model, RS-OPSD achieves SOTA performance on all three UHR remote sensing VQA benchmarks, outperforming the strongest competing methods by 1.6 percentage points on XLRS-Bench ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , 3.9 points on MME-RealWorld-RS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and 2.0 points on LRS-VQA ( Luo et al., 2025 ) .
We further instantiate the same framework with a Qwen3-VL-2B student and a privileged Qwen3-VL-8B teacher, yielding RS-OPD- Lite . Despite retaining only the 2B student at inference time, RS-OPD- Lite surpasses most 8B-scale models. Moreover, since neither variant requires additional visual search or tool calls, they both achieve low inference latency, with RS-OPD- Lite achieving the lowest inference latency, 12.8% lower than the second-fastest method.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
RS-OPSD以Quen3-VL-8B(Bai等,2025a)为基准模型,在所有三项UHR遥感VQA基准上实现SOTA性能,在XLRS-Bench(Wang等,2025b)上比最强的相竞方法高1.6个百分点;在MME-RealWorld-RS(Zhang等,2025年)上比3.9分;在LRS-VQA上比2.0分(Lo等,2025年)。
我们进一步利用一个Qune3-VL-2B学生和一位享有特权的Qune3-VL-8B教师来即兴发挥同样的框架,产生RS-OPD-Lite. 尽管在推论时间只保留了2B学生,RS-OPD-Lite超过了大多数8B级的模型. 此外,由于两个变体都需要额外的视觉搜索或工具调用,它们都实现了低推论纬度,RS-OPD-Lite实现了最低推论纬度,比第二取法低了12.8%.
我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce RS-OPSD , which formulates UHR remote sensing VQA as an on-policy self-distillation problem and internalizes the priviledge of zoom-in evidence into the model. • To support this paradigm, we construct GeoEvidence-6K , a high-quality UHR remote sensing VQA dataset with explicit evidence-region annotations. We further propose Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement , which iteratively converts accumulated human feedback into reusable annotation skills for subsequent data construction. • We develop two complementary components for reliable privileged distillation: Context-Preserving Visual Privilege , which provides the teacher with global, contextual, and fine-grained visual evidence, and Correctness-Aligned Distillation , which suppresses unreliable teacher supervision through sample-level reliability gating and correctness-aligned token updates. • Extensive experiments show that RS-OPSD achieves SOTA performance while maintaining efficient, search-free and tool-free inference. Moreover, RS-OPD- Lite retains competitive accuracy and achieves the fastest inference speed among all compared methods.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们引入RS-OPSD,它将UHR遥感VQA作为政策上的自我消化问题,并将放大证据的内在化入模型。 为了支持这一范式,我们建造了GeoEvience-6K,这是一个高质量的UHR遥感VQA数据集,有明确的证据区域说明. 我们进一步提出《人类反馈指导技能完善》,它将人类积累的反馈迭代地转换成可重复使用的注释技能,用于随后的数据构建。 我们为可靠的特权分馏开发了两个互补的组件:为教师提供全局、背景和精细的视觉证据的Content-Preading Visual Privilege, 以及通过样本级的可靠性标注和正确度相匹配的符号更新抑制不可靠的教师监督。 • 广泛的实验表明,RS-OPSD在保持高效、无搜索和无工具推断的同时,实现了SOTA的性能。 此外,RS-OPD-Lite保留了竞争性准确性,在所有比较方法中实现了最快的推论速度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , existing approaches to UHR remote sensing VQA mainly follow three paradigms: token pruning , visual search , and tool-augmented reasoning .
blocks.zh: 如图2所显示,对UHR遥感VQA的现有方法主要遵循三个范式:信使搜索、视觉搜索和工具强化推理。

blocks.en:
Token-pruning methods exploit the redundancy in UHR remote sensing imagery by retaining question-relevant visual tokens while discarding less informative regions.
GeoLLaVA-8K ( Wang et al., 2025a ) combines Background Token Pruning with Anchored Token Selection to suppress redundant background tokens while preserving object-centric visual tokens.
UHR-BAT ( Dang et al., 2026 ) further introduces query-guided multi-scale token selection and region-faithful preserve-and-merge strategies to allocate a fixed token budget toward question-relevant regions.
blocks.zh:
Token-pluning方法利用UHR遥感图象中的冗余性,保留了与问题有关的可视标志,同时抛弃了信息较少的区域.
GeoLAVA-8K (Wang等, 2025a) 将背景托肯活化与Anchored Token Choice合并,在保留以对象为中心的视觉活化符号的同时压制冗余背景活化符号.
UHR-BAT (Dang等人, 2026年) 进一步引入了由查询指导的多尺度符号选择和地区忠实的保存和融合策略,为与问题相关的区域分配固定的符号预算.

blocks.en:
Visual search methods explicitly identify informative regions and construct compact evidence from the original UHR image before reasoning, avoiding dense processing of the entire scene.
ZoomSearch ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) performs hierarchical zoom search to locate question-relevant patches and reassembles the selected evidence with spatial layout preserved.
WeaveEarth ( Ma et al., 2026 ) constructs a compact Minimal Support Evidence Set through global-aware evidence selection and integrates local evidence, spatial metadata, and relative topology for subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh:
视觉搜索方法在推理前明确识别信息区并从原始UHR图像中构建紧凑的证据,避免了整个场景的密集处理.
ZoomSearch(周克等,2025年)进行分级缩放搜索,以定位与问题相关的补丁并重新组装保留空间布局的所选证据.
WeaveEarth(Ma等,2026年)通过全球认知证据选择构建了紧凑的最小支持证据集,并整合了本地证据,空间元数据,以及相对地貌,用于后续推理.

blocks.en:
Tool-augmented reasoning methods equip VLMs with explicit visual tools, enabling active acquisition of high-resolution evidence during inference.
ZoomEarth ( Liu et al., 2026 ) introduces an active perception paradigm that learns adaptive cropping and zooming through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, allowing the model to revisit informative regions during reasoning.
Building on this direction, GeoEyes ( Wang et al., 2026 ) further addresses the tendency of zoom-enabled models to follow homogeneous tool-use patterns, learning more adaptive on-demand zooming and stopping behaviors through staged supervised and reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh:
工具增强的推理方法使VLMs具备了明确的视觉工具,使得在推论中能够积极获取高分辨率证据.
ZoomEarth(Liu等,2026年)引入了积极感知范式,通过监督的微调和强化学习来学习适应性收成和放大,使模型在推理时可以重新审视信息区.
在这个方向上,GeoEyes(Wang等,2026年)进一步解决了以放大为主的模型遵循同质工具使用模式,学习更能适应需求的放大,并通过有舞台监督的强化学习来阻止行为的趋势.

blocks.en: 3 GeoEvidence-6K
blocks.zh: 3 地证-6K

blocks.en: To provide the teacher with zoom-in visual privileges, we require high-quality UHR remote sensing data pairing each question with a target region. We therefore construct GeoEvidence-6K , a manually verified UHR remote sensing VQA dataset with explicit target-region annotations. Since annotating these regions is labor-intensive and prone to repetitive errors, we introduce Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement (HF-SR) , a human-in-the-loop annotation framework that consolidates human corrections into reusable annotation skills. Human feedback thus not only corrects individual samples but also continuously improves subsequent annotation.
blocks.zh: 为了向教师提供放大视觉特权,我们需要高质量的UHR遥感数据,将每个问题与目标区域配对。 因此,我们构建了GeoEvience-6K,这是一个人工核实的UHR遥感VQA数据集,有明确的目标区域说明. 由于对这些地区的注解是劳动密集型的,容易重复错误,因此我们引入了《人类反馈指导技能精准》(HF-SR),这是一个将人类的校正整合为可重复使用的注解技能的“即时注解框架”。 因此,人类的反馈不仅纠正了个别样本,而且还不断改进了随后的注释。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集概览

blocks.en: GeoEvidence-6K is constructed from 1,050 UHR remote sensing images collected from five public data sources, as summarized in Table 1 . The images average 10,714 × 10,714 10{,}714\times 10{,}714 pixels, with ground sampling distances (GSDs) ranging from 0.08 m to 0.50 m, and span diverse urban, agricultural, natural, coastal, and mountainous scenes. The annotated target regions average only 1,095 × 1,074 1{,}095\times 1{,}074 pixels, roughly 1 % 1\% of the full-image area. This large scale disparity highlights the difficulty of locating and resolving question-relevant visual evidence in UHR scenes.
blocks.zh: 如表1所概述,GeoEvience-6K是根据从5个公共数据来源收集的1,050 UHR遥感图像而成的。 图像平均为10,714×10,714 10{,}714\times 10{,}714像素,地面采样距离从0.08米到0.50米不等,并跨越了不同的城市,农业,自然,沿海和多山地景. 附加说明的目标区域平均只有1,095×1,074 1{,}095\times 1{,}074像素,约占全图像面积的1%. 这种大规模差异突出了在UHR场景中查找和解决与问题有关的视觉证据的困难.

blocks.en: The dataset covers seven multiple-choice task categories. Five are local-evidence tasks, including counting , position , color , category , and shape , while land-use and route-planning are global-context tasks. For each source image, we select diverse target regions and annotate questions of different task types, resulting in a total of 6,750 training samples. Representative annotations are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 数据集涵盖7个多选择任务类别. 五是本地证据任务,包括计数、位置、颜色、类别和形状等,而土地利用和路由规划则是全球背景任务。 对于每个源图像,我们选择了不同的目标区域和不同任务类型的注释问题,结果共有6,750个培训样本. 代表说明见图3。

blocks.en: 3.2 HF-SR: Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.2 HF-SR:人类反馈指导技能改进

blocks.en:
Figure 3 illustrates our HF-SR pipeline.
Let 𝒜 \mathcal{A} denote a fixed annotation agent and 𝒮 k \mathcal{S}_{k} the annotation skill at refinement stage k k . blocks.en: 5.1 Motivation

blocks.en: We first conduct a pilot study to examine whether zoom-in evidence can be directly exploited through OPSD for UHR remote sensing VQA. As shown in Table 3 , LoRA fine-tuning on GeoEvidence-6K improves the baseline from 40.8 to 45.7 on average, whereas directly applying OPSD with the evidence crop as the teacher privilege achieves only 45.2. Although OPSD still improves over the base model, it fails to outperform standard LoRA fine-tuning, suggesting that crop-based privileged distillation is not yet sufficiently effective in this setting.
blocks.zh: 我们首先进行一项试点研究,审查是否可以通过OPSD直接利用放大证据进行UHR遥感VQA。 如表3所示,LORA对GeoEvience-6K的微调平均将基线从40.8提高到45.7,而直接将OPSD与证据作物相接,因为教师特权只达到45.2。 虽然OPSD在基础模型上仍然有所改进,但是它未能超越标准的LORA微调,说明以作物为主的特权蒸馏在此背景下尚不够有效.

blocks.en:
To understand this limitation, we further evaluate the teacher–student capability gap on GeoEvidence-6K under direct-answer evaluation. Using the same Qwen3-VL-8B model, the full-image input achieves 63.85% accuracy, while the evidence crop reaches 69.91%. This diagnostic reveals two bottlenecks: first, the crop privilege provides only a 6.06-point advantage, resulting in a relatively weak privileged signal; second, the privileged model itself remains imperfect, with nearly 30% of the training samples answered incorrectly, which can introduce conflicting supervision.
These observations motivate two complementary designs in RS-OPSD : Context-Preserving Visual Privilege (CPVP) enriches the teacher with additional contextual and global information to strengthen its privileged advantage, while Correctness-Aligned Distillation (CAD) filters unreliable teacher signals and retains only update directions aligned with verified answer correctness.
blocks.zh:
为了了解这一局限性,我们将在直接回答评价下进一步评估GeoEvidence-6K上的师生能力差距。 使用同一种Quen3-VL-8B模型,全成像输入精度达到63.85%,而证据收成达到69.91%. 这种诊断揭示出两个瓶颈:第一,作物特权只提供6.06分的优势,导致特权信号相对薄弱;第二,特权模式本身仍然不完善,近30%的培训样本答错,这可能会引入相互矛盾的监督.
这些观察激发了RS-OPSD的两个互补设计: Context-Preading Visual Privilege(CPVP)使教师获得更多的背景和全局信息来强化其特权优势,而正对-相通分化(CAD)过滤不可靠的教师信号并只保留与经核实的答案正确性相匹配的更新方向.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present RS-OPSD , a reliable privileged OPSD framework for UHR remote sensing VQA. Instead of relying on additional visual search or tool use at inference time, RS-OPSD internalizes zoom-in visual privilege into the model during training. To support this paradigm, we construct GeoEvidence-6K with explicit evidence-region annotations and introduce HF-SR for human-feedback-guided data construction. We further develop CPVP to provide richer contextual and fine-grained visual privilege, and CAD to suppress unreliable teacher guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RS-OPSD achieves SOTA performance while maintaining efficient inference, and that RS-OPD- Lite further offers a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off with a substantially smaller student model. We further discuss the limitations of the current framework and potential directions for future work in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了RS-OPSD,这是UHR遥感VQA的可靠特权OPSD框架. RS-OPSD不依靠在推断时间的额外视觉搜索或工具使用,而是在训练期间将视觉特权放大到模型中. 为了支持这一范式,我们用明确的证据区域说明构建了GeoEvidence-6K,并引入了HF-SR用于人反馈制数据构建. 我们进一步发展CPVP,提供更丰富的背景和精细的视觉特权,CAD压制不可靠的教师指导. 广泛的实验表明,RS-OPSD在保持有效推论的同时实现了SOTA的性能,RS-OPD-Lite还提供了一种有利的准确性-效率取舍,而学生模式则要小得多。 我们在附录E中进一步讨论了目前框架的局限性和今后工作的潜在方向。

blocks.en: Appendix B Dataset Quality and Integrity
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集质量和完整性

blocks.en: We verified that GeoEvidence-6K has no exact image-level overlap with XLRS-Bench ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , MME-RealWorld-RS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , or LRS-VQA ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , ruling out direct train–test leakage from reused evaluation images. The annotation process involved ten domain experts with expertise in remote sensing image interpretation. All generated samples were manually reviewed, and the complete dataset underwent a final cross-validation stage across the expert pool to resolve remaining ambiguities and annotation errors. We measure annotation reliability using the Cross-Validation Acceptance Rate (CVAR), defined as the proportion of samples accepted during the final cross-validation without requiring further correction. GeoEvidence-6K achieves an overall CVAR of 97.8% , indicating a high level of consistency in the final annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们核实了GeoEvience-6K与XLRS-Bench(Wang等人,2025b),MME-RealWorld-RS(Zhang等人,2025年),或LRS-VQA(Luo等人,2025年)没有确切的图像级别重叠,排除了直接列车-测试再利用评价图像的渗出. 注释过程涉及10名具有遥感图像解释专门知识的领域专家。 所有生成的样本都经过人工审查,完整的数据集在专家库中经过了最后的交叉验证阶段,以解决剩余的模糊和注释错误。 我们使用交叉校正接受率(CVAR)测量注释的可靠性,该比率被定义为在最后交叉校正期间接受样品的比例而无需作进一步更正。 GeoEvidence-6K实现总体CVAR为97.8%,表明最终说明中的高度一致性.

blocks.en: We implement RS-OPSD using the verl ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) training framework. For each training sample, the student performs a single on-policy rollout ( n = 1 n=1 ), which is then reused for privileged-teacher evaluation, CAD computation, and reference-model regularization.

blocks.en: During training, all visual inputs are resized while preserving the original aspect ratio, with the longest image side capped at 2,048 pixels. The same preprocessing strategy is applied to the Global Evidence, Contextual Evidence, and Fine-grained Evidence. For training samples with localized evidence annotations, the student Global Evidence contains a rendered red bounding box indicating the annotated evidence region, while the privileged teacher additionally receives the corresponding contextual and fine-grained views. At inference time, we do not introduce any additional bounding boxes, crop coordinates, or localization cues beyond those originally provided by the benchmark. Specifically, MME-RealWorld-RS and LRS-VQA are evaluated using their original unmarked images, whereas a subset of XLRS-Bench samples natively contains red-circle annotations in the released benchmark images.

blocks.en: To ensure reproducibility, Figure 7 summarizes the prompt templates used during RS-OPSD training. The student receives a single full-image input together with the original question, options, and bounding-box instruction when applicable. In contrast, the privileged teacher receives three complementary views—Global Evidence, Contextual Evidence, and Fine-grained Evidence—with an explicit instruction describing the role of each view. The question and answer options are otherwise kept consistent between the student and teacher prompts. All prompts are wrapped with the Qwen chat template before being passed to the model.

blocks.en: Inference latency is measured on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with a batch size of 1. We report the average per-sample latency under the same evaluation protocol used for the three UHR remote sensing VQA benchmarks. Since RS-OPSD introduces no architectural modifications to the underlying vision-language model and requires neither additional visual search nor external tool calls at inference time, the trained model remains directly compatible with standard inference acceleration frameworks such as vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , without requiring specialized serving infrastructure.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The current formulation of RS-OPSD relies on explicit supervision at two stages. First, target-region annotations are required to construct the privileged visual inputs used by CPVP. Second, ground-truth answers are used in CAD to assess teacher reliability and determine the correctness of student rollouts. Although these annotations enable reliable privileged distillation, acquiring them for UHR remote sensing imagery introduces substantial annotation cost and limits the scalability of the framework.
blocks.zh: 目前RS-OPSD的表述依赖于两个阶段的明确监督. 首先,需要目标区域说明来构建CPVP使用的特权视觉输入. 其次,在CAD中使用了地面真实的答案来评估教师的可靠性,并确定学生推出的正确性. 虽然这些说明有助于可靠的特有蒸馏,但为了UHR遥感图像而获得这些说明会带来大量的注释成本并限制框架的可扩展性。

blocks.en: A natural extension is to explore more self-supervised forms of OPSD that reduce or remove these dependencies. Future work may investigate automatic discovery of question-relevant visual privilege without target-region annotations, as well as teacher reliability estimation without ground-truth answer constraints. More broadly, combining model-intrinsic evidence discovery with self-verification could enable privileged self-distillation to scale to larger unlabeled UHR datasets and broader high-resolution vision-language tasks.
blocks.zh: 一个自然延伸是探索更多的自我监督的OPSD形式来减少或去除这些依赖性. 今后的工作可以调查在没有目标区域说明的情况下自动发现与问题有关的视觉特权,以及教师可靠性估计,而不受地面真实答案的限制。 更广泛地说,将模型-内在证据发现与自我核查相结合,可以使特有自我消化扩大到更大的无标签UHR数据集和更广泛的高分辨率视觉语言任务。

blocks.en: Our RS-OPD- Lite experiments further suggest that visual privilege remains beneficial beyond the self-distillation setting, where a larger privileged teacher transfers knowledge to a smaller student. This observation opens another direction for privilege-enhanced model distillation , where additional training-time information can improve knowledge transfer across model scales while retaining a lightweight student at inference time. Exploring such privileged distillation may provide a promising route toward more accurate and efficient vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 我们的RS-OPD-Lite实验进一步表明,视觉特权在自我消化环境之外仍然有益,在这种环境中,一个比较有特权的教师向一个较小的学生传授知识。 这一观察为特权强化模型分馏开辟了又一方向,即额外的培训时间信息可以改善跨模型尺度的知识转让,同时在推断时间保留一个轻量级学生. 探索这种特权分馏可能为更准确、更高效的视觉语言模式提供一条有希望的道路。
